affinity.description: Affinity for Retool pods. The default prefers spreading Retool pods across nodes.

args.description: Extra arguments for the backend container.

clientSecret.description: Google OAuth client secret. Ignored when `clientSecretSecretName` is set.

clientSecretSecretKey.description: Key in `clientSecretSecretName` holding the Google client secret.

clientSecretSecretName.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the Google client secret. Use instead of `clientSecret`.

enabled.description: Set the `CLIENT_ID` and `CLIENT_SECRET` env vars for Google SSO. Defaults to true for backwards compatibility.

encryptionKey.description: Key used to encrypt secrets stored in the Retool database. Required on first install unless `config.encryptionKeySecretName` is set. Never change it after install, or stored credentials become unreadable.

encryptionKeySecretKey.description: Key in `config.encryptionKeySecretName` holding the encryption key.

encryptionKeySecretName.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the encryption key. Use instead of `config.encryptionKey`.

jwtSecret.description: Secret used to sign session JWTs. When unset, one is generated on first install and reused on upgrade. Reuse relies on Helm `lookup`, so set it explicitly with tools that render via `helm template`, such as Argo CD.

jwtSecretSecretKey.description: Key in `config.jwtSecretSecretName` holding the JWT secret.

jwtSecretSecretName.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the JWT secret. Use instead of `config.jwtSecret`.

licenseKey.description: Retool license key. Ignored when `config.licenseKeySecretName` is set.

licenseKeySecretKey.description: Key in `config.licenseKeySecretName` holding the license key.

licenseKeySecretName.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the license key. Use instead of `config.licenseKey`.

postgresPoolMaxSize.description: Maximum Postgres pool connections for the backend. Sets `DBCONNECTOR_POSTGRES_POOL_MAX_SIZE`.

database.description: Alias for `config.postgresql.db`, used when `db` is unset.

host.description: Hostname of the external Postgres database.

password.description: Database password. Ignored when `passwordSecretName` is set.

passwordSecretKey.description: Key in `passwordSecretName` holding the database password.

passwordSecretName.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the database password. Use instead of `password`.

port.description: Port of the external Postgres database.

ssl_enabled.description: Connect to Postgres over SSL. Sets `POSTGRES_SSL_ENABLED`; set it here rather than in `env`.

useInsecureCookies.description: Serve the session cookie without the `Secure` flag. Only enable this when Retool is served over plain HTTP.

env.description: Environment variables for Retool containers, as `NAME: value`. A value can also be a map with `value` and/or `valueFrom`.

environmentSecrets.description: Environment variables populated from Kubernetes Secrets. Each item has `name` and `secretKeyRef` (`name`, `key`).

environmentVariables.description: Environment variables in Kubernetes `EnvVar` form, for values `env` cannot express such as `valueFrom.fieldRef`.

enabled.description: Read env vars from the legacy [kubernetes-external-secrets](https://github.com/godaddy/kubernetes-external-secrets) controller. Deprecated in favour of `externalSecrets.externalSecretsOperator`.

backendType.description: Backend type for legacy ExternalSecret resources.

refreshInterval.description: How often to re-read secrets from the provider, as a Go duration (`1m`, `1h`). `0` fetches once.

secretRef.description: ExternalSecrets to create, each also added to pod `envFrom`. Each item needs `name` and `path`; `creationPolicy`, `deletionPolicy` and `optional` are optional.

name.description: Name of the SecretStore to read from.

useLegacyCR.description: Create `kubernetes-client.io/v1` (legacy) ExternalSecret resources instead of `external-secrets.io` ones.

includeConfigSecrets.description: Also create the chart's config Secret while external secrets are enabled. It is skipped by default so it can't clobber keys supplied by the external secret.

name.description: Name of the legacy external secret to read env vars from.

secrets.description: Additional legacy external secrets to read env vars from. Each item has a `name`.

extraConfigMapMounts.description: ConfigMaps to mount into Retool containers. Each item needs `name`, `configMap` and `mountPath`, and optionally `subPath`.

extraContainers.description: Extra containers added to the backend pods.

extraManifests.description: Extra Kubernetes manifests to deploy with the chart. Each is rendered with `tpl`, so it can use template expressions.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts added to Retool containers.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes added to Retool pods.

files.description: Legacy. Config file mounts under `/usr/share/retool/config`, keyed by filename.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full name used for resource names. Truncated to 63 characters.

hostAliases.description: Host aliases for the backend pods, in Kubernetes `HostAlias` form.

enabled.description: Create a Gateway API HTTPRoute for Retool, as an alternative to `ingress`. Requires a Gateway API implementation (e.g. GKE Gateway, Istio, Envoy Gateway, NGINX Gateway Fabric).

parentRefs.description: Gateways the route attaches to, in Gateway API `ParentReference` form.

rules.description: Full HTTPRoute rules. When unset, a catch-all rule routes all traffic to the Retool backend.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for Retool containers.

pullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for Retool pods, e.g. `[{name: my-registry}]`.

tag.description: Retool version to deploy, e.g. `3.148.12-stable`. Required: the chart does not pick a version for you.

hostName.description: Single host to route to Retool. When set, `hosts` is ignored.

hosts.description: Hosts to route. Each item has `host`, `paths` (each with a `path`) and optionally `extraPaths`, raw path entries placed first.

pathType.description: Path type for the Retool paths. Set to null to omit it.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, in Kubernetes `IngressTLS` form.

initContainers.description: Init containers for Retool pods, as a map of container name to container spec.

digest.description: Digest to pin a mirrored init image by, e.g. `sha256:...`.

repository.description: Utility image for the initContainers that install the nsjail seccomp profile on the host, used by the code executor and JS executor. Override it to pull from a private mirror, an air-gapped registry, or GCP Marketplace.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the container is restarted.

host.description: Host the probe connects to. On IPv6-primary or dual-stack clusters, set `127.0.0.1` so the kubelet probes the IPv4 loopback; some services (e.g. code-executor) listen on IPv4 only.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the probe times out.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

blockCloudMetadataEgress.description: Block backend egress to the cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254). `true`/`false` force it on or off.

blockedRanges.description: Additional IPv4 CIDRs to deny in backend egress, e.g. private ranges user-defined requests should not reach.

blockedRanges6.description: IPv6 CIDRs to deny in backend egress. Empty leaves IPv6 egress fully allowed.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the created PVC.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the created PVC.

enabled.description: Mount a PersistentVolumeClaim into the backend, jobs-runner, dbconnector, MCP, multiplayer and git server pods.

existingClaim.description: Use this existing PVC instead of creating one.

mountPath.description: Path the volume is mounted at.

size.description: Requested size of the created PVC.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the created PVC. `"-"` sets `storageClassName: ""`, which disables dynamic provisioning; empty uses the cluster default.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to all Retool pods.

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget spec for Retool deployments, with `minAvailable` or `maxUnavailable` as a pod count (`1`) or a percentage (`"50%"`). Empty creates none.

podLabels.description: Labels added to the backend and jobs-runner pods.

username.description: Database user. With `postgres`, a random admin password is generated unless `postgresPassword` is set.

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled Postgres subchart. Not suitable for production.
Persist Postgres data in a PersistentVolumeClaim.

mountPath.description: Mount path of the Postgres volume.

ssl_enabled.description: Connect to the bundled Postgres over SSL. Sets `POSTGRES_SSL_ENABLED`.

enabled.description: Sleep 30 seconds before the backend container stops, so load balancers drain it first.

host.description: Host the probe connects to. See `livenessProbe.host`.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the pod is marked ready.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the probe times out.

replicaCount.description: Number of backend replicas. With more than 1, a separate jobs-runner pod is also deployed.

allOf.description: Resources for the backend pods. Also the default for the jobs-runner, dbconnector, workflows backend, workflow workers and git server pods when they don't set their own.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old ReplicaSets to keep for rollbacks.

enabled.description: Set `runAsUser` and `fsGroup` on the main Retool pods.

extraSecurityContext.description: Additional pod security context fields for the main Retool pods, in Kubernetes `PodSecurityContext` form.

fsGroup.description: Group ID that owns mounted volumes.

enabled.description: Create an AWS SecurityGroupPolicy for Retool pods (EKS security groups for pods).

clusterIP.description: Fixed cluster IP. Only used with `type: ClusterIP`.

loadBalancerIP.description: Requested load balancer IP. Only used with `type: LoadBalancer`.

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: CIDRs allowed to reach the load balancer, where the provider supports it.

nodePort.description: Fixed node port. Only used with `type: NodePort`.

selector.description: Extra selector labels for the Service.

type.description: Service type for the Retool backend.

annotations.description: Annotations added to the ServiceAccount, e.g. for IRSA or Workload Identity.

automountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into Retool pods.

name.description: ServiceAccount to use. When `create` is true and this is unset, a name is generated from the full name. When `create` is false, it must already exist.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures before the container is restarted. With the defaults, the backend has 5 minutes to start.

host.description: Host the probe connects to. See `livenessProbe.host`.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds after container start before the first probe.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes before the probe passes.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before the probe times out.

definitions.json.$comment: Shared definitions referenced from values.yaml with `# @schema $ref: schema/definitions.json#/definitions/<name>`. generate.sh bundles them into values.schema.json.

quantity.description: A Kubernetes resource quantity, e.g. `500m`, `2`, or `4Gi`.

resources.description: Container resource requests and limits (core/v1 ResourceRequirements).
